|notes=The [[Mandalorian Mishap (V) (Virtual Set 10: Fourth Anthology) (Original 2005)|2005 original wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. Both slips target at a single site when the second mode is chosen. The original bars use of the targeted cards’ game text for the turn. The remaster expressly cancels that text for the turn, while keeping the weapons ban and separate gangster Effect suspension.
